# The Tender Desk

> The Tender Desk runs lead generation for trades (Google ads with calls straight to the business), builds websites, makes motion design videos, video ads and reels, writes tenders, runs Google Ads, sets up AI assistants and optimises sites for search and AI answers, for small and local businesses that want more of the right work. Contact: hello@thetenderdesk.co.uk

## Services
Everything is paid up front, before the work starts. Lead generation (Google ads): a set monthly fee agreed up front, paid at the start of each month. Websites are £25 for the first 6 months (site and hosting), then £75 a year. Google listing fix is a one off £49. Everything else is quoted individually after a quick chat.
* [Lead generation](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/customers/): Google ads for trades, calls straight to their phone, never shared with other firms.
* [Websites](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/websites/): custom, mobile first sites.
* [Motion, ads and reels](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/motion/): motion design videos, video ads and Instagram and TikTok reels, priced per project.
* [Care plans](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/care/): hosting, backups, updates and small changes.
* [Google SEO optimisation](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/seo/): sites set up to rank on Google and be recommended by AI answers.
* [Google Business Profiles](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/google-business/): Google listing set up or fixed, one off £49.
* [Google Ads](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/google-ads/): campaigns built and managed.
* [Tender writing](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/tenders/): finding contracts, go or no go, method statements, quality answers, social value, PQQ, SQ and frameworks.
* [AI assistant and automation](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/ai/): an assistant that answers and books customers 24/7, plus admin automations.
